title: Open Experience Explorer and Optional Day Board
summary: Replaces automatic day composition with a searchable inspiration catalogue and a simple optional drag-and-drop day board.
changes: Introduces inspiration-first browsing across structured experience categories
Adds search for intent such as breakfast, meat, beach or children
Shows five options per category by default with expandable lists
Adds manual drag-and-drop and mobile-friendly plus controls
Supports fully open free-text plan items
Persists the manual plan locally and supports copy, email and download
Removes automatic assumptions and generated schedules from the MVP
test: Confirm v2026.07.24.260 appears on desktop and mobile
Search for breakfast and confirm only relevant options appear
Open the dining and evening filters and expand a list beyond five items when available
Add cards with the plus button and by drag-and-drop
Reorder plan items and confirm the order remains after reload
Copy, email and download the plan
Confirm the experience catalogue remains useful without creating a plan
